# Cache Architecture

The cache is process-local, read-only and keyed by manifest aggregate artifact SHA-256. Runtime manifests/artifacts are recursively frozen using tuples and mapping proxies. Only the current checksum snapshot is retained. Invalidation is content-addressed; no timestamp is used. The cache writes no file, never mutates source JSON and never treats the HASK bundle directory as runtime storage. Cache disablement forces validation and reconstruction on every reload.
